ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B1-1,
Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 12-F in
the area bound by:

       West 50th Street; South Well Street; a line 125 feet north of and parallel to West 51st
       Street; and the alley next west of and parallel to South Wells Street,

to those of a RS-3, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                             ____________________________
                                                             ​
                                                             Jeanette B. Taylor
                                                             Alderwoman, 20th Ward




Common Address:
5000-5046 S. Wells Street
